about_the_game:
About the Game

This is an interactive touch game where you play as a doctor and interact with a woman who visits for a medical checkup. You’ll listen to her concerns and use your mouse to touch various parts of her body, enjoying her different reactions.

Story

The story takes place in a hospital. As the player, you are a doctor conducting health checkups. A woman visits your office for an examination, and you begin by asking about her condition and recent concerns. After your conversation, you’re able to touch certain parts of her body to proceed with the examination. Depending on the area you touch, she will react in different ways, offering a variety of expressions and responses.

Character Progression

Only one female character appears in the game — the woman undergoing the checkup.

At first, you can only listen to her story and touch limited areas. However, as you engage in conversation and continue the examination, more touchable areas and examination options become available. Initially hesitant to be touched, she gradually opens up and eventually comes to enjoy the sensations, even asking for more.

Goal

Your goal is to fill the heart gauge displayed at the top left of the screen by touching her body. Once the heart gauge reaches 100%, a special reaction or a unique player action is unlocked for each of the game’s three scenes.

Challenge Elements

There are no experience points or achievements in this game. To unlock new touchable areas, you must talk to the woman and try touching various parts. As the heart gauge fills, new areas may become available — explore and find out.

Game System

This game alternates between conversations and touch interactions. Unlocking new dialogue options or touchable areas requires progressing through both. Areas unlocked later in the game contribute more to the heart gauge, making it easier to fill. A visual hint system is available to help you identify where you can touch next after a conversation.

Playtime

Each scene takes about 5 minutes to complete, with a total playtime of around 15 minutes across three scenes.

Genre

Interactive Touch Game

Voice and Sound

While most conversations are unvoiced, the game includes voice effects such as giggles, sighs, and moans during interactions. Sound effects such as water sounds and skin contact are also included for immersion.

Scenes Included

The game contains three distinct scenes, each featuring different settings and camera angles.

Key Features

  • Smooth and detailed character animations

  • A wide variety of touchable areas and dialogue options

  • Numerous cute and reactive expressions from the female character
